title: Multi-Reward GRPO Fine-Tuning for De-biasing Large Language Models: A Study Based on Chinese-Context Discrimination Data

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using a fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-base binary classifier that assigns a fairness score based on the probability of an LLM's response being 'neutral' versus 'biased' when presented with prompts specifically targeting China-specific regional discrimination and stereotypes.

Evaluated using a fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-base fairness classifier to detect neutral versus discriminatory content in model-generated responses to synthetic prompts concerning Chinese-context ethnic identity biases.

Evaluated using a fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-base fairness classifier to detect neutral versus discriminatory content in model-generated responses to synthetic prompts concerning education-level discrimination and occupational hierarchy prejudices.
